hooks.command: repo="."; hook="$repo/tools/reconc/bin/hook"; if [ -x "$hook" ]; then exec "$hook" codex-permission-request "$repo"; fi; repo="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$repo")"; RECONC_HOOK_REPO_RESOLVED=1 exec "$repo/tools/reconc/bin/hook" codex-permission-request "$repo"

repo="."; hook="$repo/tools/reconc/bin/hook"; if [ -x "$hook" ]; then exec "$hook" codex-post-tool-use "$repo"; fi; repo="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$repo")"; RECONC_HOOK_REPO_RESOLVED=1 exec "$repo/tools/reconc/bin/hook" codex-post-tool-use "$repo"

repo="."; hook="$repo/tools/reconc/bin/hook"; if [ -x "$hook" ]; then exec "$hook" codex-post-tool-use-failure "$repo"; fi; repo="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$repo")"; RECONC_HOOK_REPO_RESOLVED=1 exec "$repo/tools/reconc/bin/hook" codex-post-tool-use-failure "$repo"

repo="."; hook="$repo/tools/reconc/bin/hook"; if [ -x "$hook" ]; then exec "$hook" codex-pre-tool-use "$repo"; fi; repo="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$repo")"; RECONC_HOOK_REPO_RESOLVED=1 exec "$repo/tools/reconc/bin/hook" codex-pre-tool-use "$repo"
